06June · Water loss

Leak, or just the sun?

In a desert summer a pool can lose half an inch a day to the air. The bucket test tells you if something else is wrong before anyone drills.

We walk you through it over text, or come out and run it with dye. If it is evaporation, there is no bill.

Normal July sun: ¼ to ½ in.

Almanac entryWater loss

Half an inch a day is the top of normal in July. Run the bucket test before anyone calls it a leak.

07July · Monsoon

Haboob dust in, chlorine burned off

In July a desert pool can drop ¼ to ½ inch a day, and one haboob can load a cartridge filter in an afternoon. Weekly service catches both.

  1. ¼–½in. a day

    Evaporation

    Normal in July. More than that, run the bucket test.

  2. 2ppm at sundown

    Chlorine

    Free chlorine under 2 ppm at sundown means algae by morning.

  3. 1afternoon

    Dust

    Monsoon storms drop fine silt that clogs a cartridge filter overnight.

11November · Resurfacing

Pick the right month to pour

Pebble and plaster cure best when nights stay above 50° and days stay under 90°. Summer pours crack and chalk.

October–April: pour

Nights above 50°, days under 90°. Pebble gets the slow cure it needs. Ask for a November date when you call.

May–September: wait

Decks over 110° flash-cure the mix and leave hairline cracks and a chalky finish. A summer pour is the one we talk people out of.
